type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] (α : σ → R) (j : σ) (P : MvPolynomial σ R), MvPolynomial.degreeOf j (MvPolynomial.taylor α P) ≤ MvPolynomial.degreeOf j P
what: Constant coordinate translation does not increase degree in any chosen variable.
how: An exponent above the original coordinate degree has zero Hasse derivative, hence zero translated coefficient; apply the support characterization of degree.
hypotheses: Arbitrary independent-universe σ,R; CommSemiring R; arbitrary shift, variable and polynomial. No finiteness, nonzero, domain or characteristic restriction.
caller_summary: One explicit caller Roth.index_le_card Index229; full copied proof verified using fresh target replay.
mathlib_api_audit: Existing degreeOf_le_iff and degree bounds on sums/products do not prove the essential translated coefficient vanishing. Polynomial.natDegree_taylor is univariate; aeval_natDegree_le uses total degree and a univariate target.
moral_duplications: Univariate Taylor degree invariance is analogous but not direct replacement. Direct aeval spelling is definitionally equivalent.
generalization: Maximal within CommSemiring parent interface; CommRing equality via inverse is a separately verified stronger specialization, not assumption weakening.
missing_api: Coordinate-degree control under multivariate constant-shift substitution, with arbitrary variable type and commutative-semiring coefficients.
junk: Used by index/cardinality bound; not dead code. Short proof relies on genuine new Hasse/Taylor content.
action: Propose in Mathlib/Algebra/MvPolynomial/Taylor.lean with coefficient Taylor and Hasse degree/vanishing API; direct aeval statement if named translation is declined.
